newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: OCBC says Pacific Bank merger protracted.
newsitem.headline: OCBC says Pacific Bank merger protracted.

text.p: Overseas-Chinese Banking Corp Ltd (OCBC) said on Wednesday merger talks with Malaysian Pacific Bank Bhd had been "protracted".
It said in a statement that discussions were continuing and all parties hoped to arrive at a decision in the near future.

OCBC said that since the talks concerned three parties -- OCBC Bank Bhd, Pacific Bank Bhd and the Malaysian operations of OCBC's insurance unit Great Eastern Life Assurance Co -- negotiations on detailed arrangements had been lengthy.

"In the event that full agreement is reached, and upon the approval of Bank Negara Malaysia and the Monetary Authority of Singapore, a public statement will be issued for release to inform shareholders," the bank said.
OCBC said on May 23 last year it was beginning talks to merge its Malaysian unit with Pacific Bank to form a single but larger Malaysian financial institution.
As a publicly-listed Malaysian commercial bank, the new entity would be the fourth largest in Malaysia.
